search_result = await run_command("""python -c "
import sqlite3, json
conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')

# Check for flights from ACC, ABV, or any other West African airports
west_african = ['ACC', 'ABV', 'LOS', 'LAG', 'ABJ', 'DKR', 'LFW']
print('=== Checking West African origins ===')
for code in west_african:
    c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE origin=?', (code,))
    cnt = c.fetchone()[0]
    if cnt > 0:
        print(f'  {code}: {cnt} flights found')
    else:
        print(f'  {code}: no flights')

# Full list of all origin airports
print()
print('=== ALL origin airports in system ===')
c.execute('SELECT DISTINCT origin FROM flights ORDER BY origin')
origins = [r[0] for r in c.fetchall()]
print(origins)

# Full list of all destination airports
print()
print('=== ALL destination airports in system ===')
c.execute('SELECT DISTINCT destination FROM flights ORDER BY destination')
dests = [r[0] for r in c.fetchall()]
print(dests)

# Now find ALL possible one-stop itineraries to LHR
# A one-stop = Leg1 (any origin -> connecting city) + Leg2 (connecting city -> LHR)
print()
print('=== ALL possible one-stop routes to LHR ===')
c.execute('''
    SELECT 
        f1.flight_id as leg1_id, f1.origin as leg1_origin, f1.destination as connection,
        f1.departure_time as leg1_depart, f1.arrival_time as leg1_arrive,
        f1.cabin_prices_json as leg1_prices, f1.dates_json as leg1_dates, f1.status as leg1_status,
        f2.flight_id as leg2_id, f2.origin as leg2_origin, f2.destination as leg2_dest,
        f2.departure_time as leg2_depart, f2.arrival_time as leg2_arrive,
        f2.cabin_prices_json as leg2_prices, f2.dates_json as leg2_dates, f2.status as leg2_status
    FROM flights f1
    JOIN flights f2 ON f1.destination = f2.origin
    WHERE f2.destination = 'LHR'
    AND f1.status = 'scheduled'
    AND f2.status = 'scheduled'
    ORDER BY f1.origin, f1.departure_time
''')
rows = c.fetchall()
print(f'Found {len(rows)} possible one-stop combinations to LHR')
for row in rows:
    r = dict(row)
    print(json.dumps(r, indent=2))

conn.close()
"
""")
print(search_result)
